source_execution: Use launch_frozen.py from the workflow root; it verifies every frozen file and all imported live Python source hashes before binding or collecting. Do not execute the snapshot as an independent working directory.
statistical_interpretation: The sign-flip p-values are symmetry/exchangeability-based reference tests on paired world contrasts. Enumerating every sign when n<=20 makes the reference distribution exact; deterministic paired arms alone do not provide randomized treatment allocation. Family-stratified world bootstrap intervals remain the primary uncertainty description.
